status: d2c_implemented; final-release order intervention pre-registered; offline verification passed; no run

delay.location: inside the final OPEN, after ungrasp returns and before the original upward retreat target motion
delay.hold: keep the current position target and open gripper; do not reset cloth position or velocity
delay.verification: exactly 120 physics steps; no control call, target change, cloth position write or velocity clear

phase_labels.retreat: the original upward retreat state rows

event_recording.per_step: vertices, EE pose/quaternion, all joints, aperture, attachment flags in release_diag.npz
event_recording.event_state: event rows include EE, joints, aperture, attachment and cloth centroid/hash

evaluation.time_alignment: t=0 is the attachment-disable step read from release_diag attachment flags, not delay_begin; compare by elapsed time after attachment release, not by absolute step.  Action-relative stage windows are reported separately.

notes: D2-C is a new independent diagnostic version; D1-120, RC2 and v1.1 directories are not modified.
Only the final-release order is changed: open gripper while attachment is enabled, suppress the redundant open inside original ungrasp, then disable the attachment.
12 public actions, targets, commands and horizons remain unchanged; the 120-step wait and retreat target remain.
No friction value is changed and no cloth velocity is cleared as a fix.
One 4202 single run only; formal thresholds 1 mm / 3 mm remain; formal batch paused.
Compared with D1-120, total physics steps are unchanged: the same 10 gripper-opening steps now occur before attachment disable; the 120-step wait is retained.
scope: D2-C single release-order intervention on top of D1-120; 4202 single only

release_order.location: final public OPEN/release_retreat, before attachment disable
release_order.why: D2-A/B showed attachment disabled at 1944 while gripper_state/command latch remained non-open until 1953; release-step velocity jumped 17.4/11.0 mm/s. This single change keeps attachment until the 10-step gripper opening completes.

expected_phenomenon: attachment remains enabled during the 10-step gripper opening and is disabled after preopen
release-step and first-5-step particle/centroid/angular speeds decrease versus D1
if the release impulse is causal, wait/retreat/formal-window centroid and P95 drift decrease versus D1
if unchanged, release order is not the dominant cause; do not infer from a single run beyond the pre-registered metrics

comparison.against: a5-rc2-d1-120 clean run and RC2 4202 single
comparison.alignment: release t=0 = released sample immediately after all three attachment slots become false; report its observed_step delta from the last preopen state; transient 0..30 steps (0..0.5 s), later slip 30..120 steps; wait window release+0..120 steps for both runs so D1 includes its 10 opening steps; retreat and formal 210..330 remain action-relative stage metrics.
primary: release-step particle mean speed at attachment disable
release+0..120 step centroid/P95/rotation (D1 includes its 10 opening steps)

analysis_plan.release_t0: released sample row emitted immediately after attachment disable; it must share observed_step with the last preopen state.  The first all-off state row is one step later and is not used as the exact release instant.
analysis_plan.wait_window: release+0..120 steps for both runs; D1 opening steps are included in its post-release window
analysis_plan.stage_windows: retreat and formal 210..330 aligned by public action step, reported separately
analysis_plan.contact: cloth-ground contact force/impulse is unavailable; use particle/centroid speed, height and penetration
analysis_plan.missing: normal/tangential contact force or impulse cannot be claimed
analysis_plan.release_sampling: record last preopen state step, release boundary observed step, released sample step and their delta; if delta is nonzero report the sampling error instead of claiming an exact instant; the released sample is a zero-physics-step state read at the boundary
